summary: Automad is a flat-file content management system combined with an integrated template engine. It allows you to build and manage websites directly from text files stored on your server without needing a separate relational database. Content is structured and rendered through its native templating syntax.
goodFor: Deployments where you want a lightweight, file-based publishing workflow without the overhead of managing a traditional database-backed CMS.
watchOut: Flat-file architectures can become harder to query and manage efficiently as content volume grows very large. It also has a smaller community and ecosystem compared to dominant alternatives like WordPress.
deployNotes: Because it relies on a flat-file structure, you must ensure that your persistent storage volume is correctly mounted for your Docker container. You will also typically need to place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and domain routing.
